exempt._composite_group_agg_fe: per-group mean/std/count over integer key codes: a numba kernel bit-equal to pandas (2 ms per 20000-row column, 30 columns x 3 stats in 0.062 s); the candidate scoring that follows is the device-batched CMI (batched_cmi_gpu, chunked on OOM). A device twin would need the pandas Kahan/Welford order replayed per group to stay bit-equal and saves less than its own column transfer (audit 73cm); revisit if the generation share of a fit grows
